definitions.explanation: Saving a file by replacing the existing version with the updated one. The standard "Save" command in most software applications, as opposed to "Save As."

examples.japanese: {上書|うわが}き{保存|ほぞん}しますか？
examples.english: Do you want to overwrite and save?

examples.japanese: Ctrl+Sで{上書|うわが}き{保存|ほぞん}ができます。
examples.english: You can overwrite save with Ctrl+S.

examples.japanese: {間違|まちが}えて{上書|うわが}き{保存|ほぞん}してしまい、{元|もと}のファイルが{消|き}えてしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally overwrote the file and the original was lost.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {上書|うわが}き (overwriting) and {保存|ほぞん} (saving, preservation). This is the Japanese equivalent of the "Save" function in most software menus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上書|うわが}き{保存|ほぞん}する (to overwrite save)
- {上書|うわが}き{保存|ほぞん}しますか？ (Do you want to save?)

RELATED WORDS:
- {名前|なまえ}を{付|つ}けて{保存|ほぞん}: Save As
- {自動保存|じどうほぞん}: auto-save
- {上書|うわが}き: overwriting
